security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation examples, Markdown backticks, placeholder URLs, or relative links, so they are false positives. Confirmed risk is limited to expected deployment commands that run npm scripts and broad git staging or pushing. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Broad staging command can include unrelated files.
remediation.suggestion: Replace git add . with scoped paths and require git status plus staged diff review before commit.

remediation.issue: NPM install and build commands execute project-controlled scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to run npm commands only in trusted repositories after reviewing package scripts and dependency changes.

remediation.issue: GitHub token guidance could be copied into broad workflow environments.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that GITHUB_TOKEN should remain scoped to required deployment steps and minimum workflow permissions.

content.user_title: Deploy Docusaurus Sites to GitHub Pages
content.value_statement: Docusaurus deployments often fail because configuration, build output, and GitHub Pages settings do not match. This skill guides setup, validation, CI workflow creation, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Docusaurus project structure and required configuration files.
Explains GitHub Pages settings for user sites and project sites.
Guides local validation with dependency install, type checks, build, and serve steps.
Provides a GitHub Actions workflow pattern for Pages deployment.
Troubleshoots common build, routing, workflow, and content quality issues.
limitations: Requires access to the user repository and Docusaurus project files.
Does not deploy without running local commands or creating workflow changes.
Cannot guarantee GitHub Pages availability or account-level repository settings.
Project-specific npm scripts may execute code from the target repository.

use_cases.title: Publish a Documentation Site
use_cases.description: Configure base URL, repository settings, and local validation before publishing a Docusaurus site to GitHub Pages.

use_cases.title: Add CI Deployment
use_cases.description: Create or adjust a GitHub Actions workflow that builds Docusaurus and deploys the generated static site.

use_cases.title: Fix Failed Deployments
use_cases.description: Diagnose 404 pages, build failures, broken links, workflow permission errors, and incorrect working directories.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single Docusaurus site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Deploy my Docusaurus site to GitHub Pages. Check the config, run local validation, and explain each required setting before changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Add GitHub Actions deployment to an existing repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up GitHub Actions for a Docusaurus project in [directory]. Use GitHub Pages source and adjust workflow paths to this repository.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate a deployment that fails locally or in CI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Troubleshoot a failed Docusaurus GitHub Pages deployment using local build logs and GitHub Actions logs. Identify root cause and minimal fix.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Release Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pre-publish review for complex repositories.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this monorepo Docusaurus deployment for baseUrl, workflow permissions, dependency scripts, build output, and safe commit scope before publishing.

output_examples.input: Deploy a project pages site from apps/docs.
output_examples.output: A deployment plan covering target URL, base path, workflow path changes, local validation steps, and post-deploy checks.

output_examples.input: A GitHub Pages site shows 404 after a successful workflow run.
output: Identifies likely base URL or Pages source mismatch.
Recommends local build and artifact checks before another push.

output_examples.input: Add deployment checks before publishing documentation updates.
output_examples.output: A validation checklist for type checks, production build, local serving, content links, frontmatter, and responsive navigation.

best_practices: Run type checks and production builds locally before pushing deployment changes.
Review staged files before committing, especially when workflow or configuration files changed.
Keep GitHub Actions permissions limited to the permissions required for Pages deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not push to main before confirming local build output and navigation.
Do not hardcode production site URLs inside documentation links when relative links work.
Do not pass repository secrets into build steps unless the deployment requires them.

faq.question: What deployment target does this skill support?
faq.answer: It focuses on Docusaurus deployment to GitHub Pages using local validation and GitHub Actions.

faq.question: Does it support project pages and user pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains the different url, baseUrl, projectName, and deployment branch requirements for both targets.

faq.question: Will it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill includes npm and git command guidance. Users should review commands and repository state before execution.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot 404 errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks base URL settings, Pages source configuration, build output, and workflow results.

faq.question: Does it require GitHub secrets?
faq.answer: Basic GitHub Pages deployment usually uses GitHub provided permissions. Extra secrets should only be added when required.

faq.question: Can it validate documentation quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes checks for frontmatter, MDX syntax, links, navigation, responsive behavior, and build output.
